inlines.v: AN'IMATE, verb intransitive [Latin amino. See Animal.] 1. To give natural life to; to quicken; to make alive; as the soul animates the body. 2. To give powers to, or to heighten the powers or effect of a thing; as, to animate a lyre. 3. To give spirit or vigor; to infuse courage, joy, or other enlivening passion; to stimulate or incite; as, to animate dispirited troops. AN'IMATE, adjective Alive; possessing animal life. [This word is used chiefly in poetry for animated.]
